Starmoto Lumation 20-Inch Electric Bike
Introduce your young rider to the next level of cycling adventure with the Starmoto Lumation Kids' Electric Bike. Expertly designed with 20-inch compact wheels, a sleek geometric frame, and adaptive electric drive modes, this youth e-bike combines agile steering with robust performance. Perfect for adventurous kids aged 8 and up and adult commuter, it turns neighborhood streets and hilly pathways into effortless terrain.

Sleek frame styling meets clean battery integration: The Starmoto Lumation.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Engineered to blend premium electric assistance with responsive control systems, the Richmond allows kids to grow their range with complete safety."
Powerful & Efficient Brushless Hub Motor
At the core of the Richmond is a dependable 750W high-speed brushless rear hub motor, delivering up to 46 Nm of torque to smoothly glide over steep hills and inclines without sudden, unsettling jerks. To ensure parents have complete peace of mind, the motor features a calibrated power limit that caps top speeds at a safe and manageable 25 MPH.

High-torque 750W brushless motor engineered to conquer hills cleanly and efficiently.

Advanced Safety Systems & Control
Safety is woven directly into every component. The bike features premium front and rear mechanical disc brakes for crisp, all-weather stopping capacity right from the hand brake levers. Coupled with ergonomic, anti-slip rubber handlebar grips, young hands maintain absolute, positive authority over steering and speed selection.
Smart Riding Ergonomics

Three-Mode Functionality: Pedal Assist Mode (motor-boosted hills) , Pure Electric Mode and pure *Cycling Mode* (traditional single-speed muscle exercise).

Weather-Proof Battery Integration: Features a high-capacity 36V frame-mounted Lithium-ion battery sealed inside an IPX5 waterproof enclosure, offering 15–30 miles of continuous trail play per charge.

LED Dashboard: A streamlined, handle-integrated controller displays battery health levels and power settings clearly, even in direct sunlight.

Quick & Easy Assembly
We understand that the excitement of a new ride shouldn't be stalled by hours of complicated assembly. The Starmoto Lumation arrives at your door largely pre-assembled with a minimalist, low-maintenance single-speed layout. Inside the package, you will find all the required specialized tools and an easy-to-read manual to guide you through installing the front wheel, adjusting the handlebars, and threading the pedals.

Watch: Quick assembly tutorial to get your Starmoto Lumation operational in minutes.

Size Chart & Fit Guide
Built with a highly stable geometric structure, this e-bike is designed to conform to growing kids seamlessly. The quick-release seat post expands vertically by up to 4 inches, ensuring the proper leg extension across multiple growth spurts.

See It In Action

Watch the Starmoto Lumation navigate coastal turns and narrow community streets with agile ease.

Our Guarantee
Your investment is fully guarded. We stand firmly behind our engineering with a comprehensive Limited Manufacturer Frame Warranty alongside a flexible return policy. Our global customer support team is available around the clock to supply parts, troubleshooting guidance, and maintenance support so your young cyclist never misses a day of outdoor play. We extend our commitment beyond the metal: the motor, battery, and controller are protected by a comprehensive 1-year technical guarantee
